appliesTo: Release admission for Social Studies lessons, read from source-projection.json.

rules.condition: The lesson's unit has a verified anchor set that still passes tools/build-projection.py's checks: every anchor VERIFIED, every anchor's link resolving, and the unit's anchor minimums met.
rules.onFailure: The projection reclassifies the lesson UNRESOLVED. Admission must follow the projection, not a remembered earlier result.

rules.condition: An attachment record in attachments.json satisfies every clause of DYNAMIC_SOURCE_REQUIREMENT for this lesson and its unit.
rules.onFailure: The lesson is PENDING_SOURCE_ATTACHMENT or ATTACHED_INCOMPLETE. It is reported as pending and is not admitted. It is never reported READY on the strength of the contract existing.

rules.condition: None. No verified static source set and no dynamic contract.

Outside both source registries -- grades 9-12. The gate input's own sourceIntegrityStatus assertion stands unchanged and unchecked by this lane. The readiness report splits its READY count so this group is never presented as verified here.
rules.onFailure: This lane makes no claim. `admissible` is null -- a release must not read null as true.

invariants: A pending lesson is reported as pending. No lane in this directory may write READY, VERIFIED, or an anchor key for a lesson whose source was not actually checked.
The readiness report is generated from the projection by tools/reevaluate-readiness.mjs, so the two cannot disagree, and it states how much of its READY count rests on a source this lane checked.
Machine-checked at build time: anchor status, anchor link resolution (a missing link check fails closed), the anchor minimums, and every structural clause of a dynamic attachment.

Not machine-checked, and therefore a human obligation before release: whether a repository record has changed since capture (run tools/verify-era1.py and act on any DRIFT or FAILED), and whether an attached dynamic source really says what the attesting adult says it says.
A dynamic attachment decays faster than a static one. The 180-day window in DYNAMIC_SOURCE_REQUIREMENT.revalidation is enforced at build time against retrievedOn and selectedOn.

currentState.statement: No attachment has been recorded, so all 12 contract-governed lessons are PENDING_SOURCE_ATTACHMENT and none is admitted.
